purpose: Document the ONLY conditions under which a new 600-series activation review may be initiated. This registry is the single source of truth until superseded by a future Governance Board vote.
authority: S600 Charter §5 (Activation Conditions), S724 Agent V Governance Preservation (5 reactivation criteria), S725 Lane 600 §Stewardship Framework
governing_principle: Activation review MAY ONLY be initiated when a trigger condition in this registry is satisfied. No other condition, argument, or request may trigger activation review. This registry supersedes all informal activation discussions.

mandatory_gates_all_four.description: S600 Charter §5 requires ALL 4 mandatory gates to pass before activation can proceed. None is individually sufficient. All 4 must be PASS simultaneously.

gates.label: Economic Gate — Forecast Savings > Startup Cost
gates.pass_condition: Independent 300-series analytics must verify Forecast Savings exceeds Startup Cost using current (not S724-era) data. S724 estimate may not be reused. The 300-series Forecast Engine (S309) must be updated with current portfolio state and produce a formal savings projection.
gates.last_verified_by: S724 Agent I Throughput Model + Agent R Session Reduction Forecast + Agent M Resource Efficiency
gates.verification_methodology: Independent 300-series re-verification using current certified pool (2,201), current remaining workload (~299 items), and 800-series observed throughput.
gates.notes: S601 Agent G confirmed: no assumption changes alter the -1 net effect. Governance overhead has INCREASED since S724 (S725/S726/S727 ceremonies). Breakeven at 36 sessions remains unreachable within 20-session program horizon.

gates.label: Governance Board Approval — New Executive Board Vote Required
gates.pass_condition: A NEW Executive Board vote must be held. Minimum requirement: 300-series Lead confirms binding constraint shifted, 700-series Governance Auditor confirms no ownership conflicts, 800-series Certification Lead confirms drafting capacity is active bottleneck. ALL THREE leads must vote to activate. The S724 26/26 DEFER vote CANNOT be reused.
gates.notes: S601: 0 of 3 required lead confirmations. S724 vote unreversed. GAP-3 ownership acceptance PENDING — the Governance Board, which would hold this vote, has not accepted stewardship of the 600-series lane.

gates.label: No Ownership Conflict — All Overlaps Resolved
gates.pass_condition: Two MEDIUM overlaps (C-001: 800 handoff friction, C-002: 700 authority drift) must be formally resolved, not deferred. Resolution must include: joint rubric for the ambiguous boundary, documented acceptance by BOTH affected lanes (700 and 800), and an update to S725 Ownership Matrix reflecting resolution (new or amended rows).
gates.last_reviewed: S601 Agent B (2026-07-26) — 95/100 boundary integrity. C-001/C-002 carried forward as unresolved.
gates.notes: Cannot be resolved while 600 is dormant — both overlaps involve live operational boundaries. Must be resolved DURING the activation review, not deferred again.

gates.label: Pre-Launch Governance Baseline Captured
gates.pass_condition: Full T0 governance baseline captured before any 600-series agent executes. Minimum: all 13 runtime hashes verified against CURRENT_BASELINES.md, certified pool count verified by direct raw-file grep, all active defect manifests reviewed for 600-relevant entries, activation decision recorded in REVISION_HISTORY.md with binding-constraint evidence, updated Forecast Savings calculation, Governance Board vote record, and T0 baseline snapshot.
gates.notes: S600 Charter §5.4 specifies exact REVISION_HISTORY.md entry requirements. The baseline must be captured at the moment of activation, not earlier.

reactivation_worth_evaluating.description: S600 Charter §1.3 identifies conditions under which reactivation becomes worth re-evaluating, independent of the mandatory gates. These are NOT sufficient for activation — they are triggers for initiating a new activation review.

conditions.label: Binding constraint shifts to drafting capacity
conditions.detail: S724 identified author capacity, not tooling, as the binding constraint. If the 800-series pipeline becomes throughput-limited by drafting capacity (EW authoring) rather than review capacity (CAQS §1.6 audit), the 600-series becomes relevant. Must be confirmed by 300-series analytics and 800-series Lead.
conditions.measurement: 800-series observed throughput ÷ items-per-session. If throughput is consistently bottlenecked at EW authoring (not certification audit), this trigger fires.

conditions.label: Modernization backlog exceeds 50+ pending items at steady state
conditions.detail: Current pending count: ~299 items (non-Certified). However, these are spread across certification waves (D/F sections), operational defects (DL-008, DL-026), and content-authoring backlogs — not a single drafting queue. A 600-series drafting lane would only help if the backlog is primarily drafting-limited.
conditions.measurement: Count of items in 'In Audit' state with DL-013/DL-026/DL-025 requiring EW authoring. If >= 50 are blocked specifically on EW authoring (not on audit capacity), this trigger fires.

conditions.label: Dedicated drafting lane clears certification faster than adding authors to 800
conditions.detail: Must be demonstrated by 300-series simulation before activation. S724 Agent M showed breakeven at 36 sessions — unreachable within 20-session horizon. This trigger requires evidence that 600 would actually improve throughput, not just add overhead.
conditions.measurement: 300-series simulation: compare (800 with 4 authorized authors) vs. (800 with 2 authors + 600 with 2 drafters). The 600 scenario must show >= 2 sessions saved.

agent_v_preservation_criteria.description: S724 Agent V Governance Preservation report defined 5 criteria covering both charter and operational readiness. These are layered on top of the mandatory gates — criteria 1-2 overlap with GATE_ECONOMIC and GATE_BOARD; criteria 3-5 are additional operational requirements.

criteria.label: EW authoring velocity empirically confirmed as the binding constraint
Portfolio grows to 5,000+ items making dedicated infrastructure cost-effective
criteria.detail: Current: 2,985 items in MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md + 10 Wave 2 production = 2,995. 500 items/pack × 5 packs = 2,500 MCQ. 420 case items. 800-series Domain E replacement items. Growth trajectory does not reach 5,000 within program horizon.

criteria.label: Observed cert velocity drops below 10 items/session due to EW-blocked items
criteria.detail: No 800-series certification wave has had throughput limited by EW authoring. S316 certified 10 items in a single production session. No throughput data suggests EW-blocked velocity below 10 items/session.

criteria.label: Post-certification modernization phase where batch DL-013/DL-031 ops become new bottleneck
criteria.detail: Post-certification modernization (800-series after 100% Certified) is theoretical. DL-013 (~851 fields remaining) and DL-031 (~500 DifficultyScore miscalibrations) are deferred to certification waves, not a separate modernization phase.

criteria.label: New Executive Board vote required — S724 DEFER vote CANNOT be reused

economic_model_assumptions.description: Current assumptions in the S724 economic model. Any material change to these assumptions that would flip the Economic Gate from FAIL to PASS constitutes a valid trigger for re-evaluation.

assumptions.label: Savings ceiling is 3 sessions over program lifetime
800-series throughput at 12-15 items/session
assumptions.relevance: Larger throughput = faster completion = fewer sessions for 600 to amortize across

assumptions.label: EW acceptance rate 70-80% (unvalidated)
assumptions.relevance: Lower acceptance = wasted drafting = higher effective cost per accepted EW

assumptions.label: Remaining workload ~299 items
assumptions.relevance: Smaller remaining = fewer sessions = harder to amortize startup cost

prohibited_activation_paths.description: The following paths are explicitly documented as invalid for 600-series activation, to prevent future governance ambiguity.
paths: S724 26/26 DEFER vote reused as activation authority (charter §5.2 explicitly prohibits)
Activation by implication or 'de facto' operation (requires explicit vote)
Activation via stealth authoring (any 600-series artifact creation constitutes an attempted activation and is a governance violation per S600 §0)
Activation via 'pilot' or 'trial' without full mandatory gate satisfaction
Activation by any single lane lead without full Executive Board vote (3 leads minimum)
Activation by S601 Agent K Board Decision reinterpretation (S601 explicitly voted KEEP DEFERRED)
Activation by 'Agent AA' delegation (Agent AA is a 700/800 operational concern, not a 600-series activation path)

next_mandatory_review.trigger: Annual stewardship review per S725 Row 16 cadence, or when any mandatory gate flips to PASS
next_mandatory_review.review_scope: Re-evaluate all 4 mandatory gates against current portfolio state

registry_maintainer: Governance Board (S725 Row 16, Stewardship of 600-series deferred lane)
